Messages.Author: Lemminkäinen
Messages.Body:
If you ever wanted to sit at a table, do a looooooong round and then go away saying that you'll do nothing for the rest of the game ruining your predator's game then this is the deck for you.

If you encounter a card that you haven't played, play it, otherwise hunt and Freak Drive. Depending on the draw, you might be sitting on 179 pool at the end of the "big" round.

You will most likely be allowed to withdraw, so there's a very good chance for a VP.

Deck Name : Trolololol

Crypt [12 vampires] Capacity min: 7 max: 7 average: 7
12x  Rabbat, The Sewer Goddess  (7)     Nosferatu (group 4)

Library [90 cards]

Action [3]
3x  Clan Impersonation

Action Modifier [81]
81x  Freak Drive

Equipment [6]
3x  Aaron's Feeding Razor
3x  Journal of Hrorsh

Crafted with : Anarch Revolt Deck Builder. [Thu Feb 23 21:36:14 2012]

P.S. Not serious
